9 December 1946

SHRI JAWAHARLAL NEHRU: Mr. President, I beg to move the following Objectives Resolution. This resolution sets out the fundamental principles upon which our Constitution is to be built. India is to be an independent sovereign republic. DR. B.R. AMBEDKAR: Mr. President, I rise to support the Objectives Resolution moved by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru. The principles stated in this resolution are ones that every member of this House would agree with. We must ensure that equality of status and of opportunity shall be assured to all citizens. SHRI T.T. KRISHNAMACHARI: Mr. President, I also support the Objectives Resolution. The resolution before us is a statement of aims and aspirations of the people of India.
